info.title: F-Grade Corporate AI CRM API
info.description: Single CRM data retrieval API for the F-Grade Corporate AI Agent. Receives a structured request generated from the user's natural-language CRM request and retrieves live Zoho CRM records. The API is the only CRM API exposed to Copilot Studio. Activity Reports and Audit Logs are not implemented in Phase 1.
info.x-copilot-studio-tool-description: Use this API whenever current or live Zoho CRM information is required, including filtering, sorting, counting, comparing, and retrieving CRM records. First understand the user's question, select the correct CRM module and required Zoho CRM API fields, convert every user condition into structured filters, and send the structured request to this API. Treat the returned data array as authoritative and analyze every record in it. Never return only the first matching record and never invent CRM records. For a new question, use limit 20 and offset 0. If pagination.more_records is true, show the available records from the returned page and explain that additional records are available; request another page only when the user asks for more or clearly continues the same search, preserving the exact module, fields, filters, sort_field, and sort_order while increasing offset by the previous limit. Reset offset to 0 for a new question. Activity Reports and Audit Logs are not implemented in Phase 1 and must not be exposed as separate operations.

post.summary: Retrieve live CRM data from a structured request
post.description: The only CRM operation exposed to Copilot Studio. Use it for live Zoho CRM records. Select the correct module and actual Zoho CRM API fields, convert each user condition into a structured filter, and send the request here. Analyze every record in the returned data array; do not invent records or claim a result is complete while pagination.more_records is true. New questions start with limit 20 and offset 0. For an explicit continuation such as show more, give me more, next 20, or continue, call this same operation with the same module, fields, filters, sort_field, and sort_order, increasing offset by the previous limit. Activity Reports and Audit Logs are not implemented in Phase 1 and have no separate operations.

400.description: The structured CRM request failed validation or contains invalid JSON.

502.description: Zoho CRM configuration, authentication, or retrieval failure.

fields.description: Non-empty list of actual Zoho CRM API field names required to answer the user's question. Never use human-readable display labels and select fields dynamically from the configured module mapping.

filters.description: Optional structured conditions used to filter CRM records. Multiple filters are combined as AND conditions.

sort_field.description: Zoho CRM API field used to sort the returned records.

sort_order.description: Sort direction: asc for ascending or desc for descending.

limit.description: Maximum number of CRM records to return. The first request for a new question should normally use 20.

offset.description: Number of CRM records to skip for pagination. A new CRM question must start at 0; a continuation may use the next offset after the previous limit.

field.description: Zoho CRM API field on which the filter is applied.

value.description: Filter value. Numeric comparison values such as 50000 may be sent as strings by Copilot Studio and are interpreted by the backend for numeric comparisons. Use a scalar string for equals, contains, and comparisons; use the backend-supported scalar array for in and exactly two scalar values for between. Omit value for is_null and is_not_null.

success.description: Indicates whether the CRM request completed successfully.

module.description: The Zoho CRM module from which the records were retrieved.

count.description: Number of CRM records returned in the current response.

data.description: The actual CRM records returned by Zoho CRM. Use this data to answer the user's request.

limit.description: Maximum number of CRM records returned in this response.

offset.description: Number of CRM records skipped before this response.

more_records.description: Indicates whether additional CRM records are available beyond the current response.

success.description: Indicates whether the CRM request completed successfully.

error.description: Structured error information returned by the backend.

details.description: Additional structured error details, when available.
